notes.title: Watch the dev try to beat the first boss!
notes.notes: After some bug fixes and some more balancing, let's see if the dev can get past the first boss!

notes.title: Watch the dev try to balance the game!
notes.notes:
Hi guys!
Balancing a survivor game is much harder than I thought. Each changed variable can radically impact the others.
Much work still needs to be done to balance Emancipator GO! properly. But here you can follow a small interactive process trying to hit the ideal difficulty level of the first stage of the game.
